newsitem.title: USA: Dow ends higher, though off early gains.
newsitem.headline: Dow ends higher, though off early gains.

text.p: Wall Street stocks ended higher Friday, boosted by a strong bond market, a growing belief that interest rates will hold steady next week and fund managers adjusting their portfolios before the second quarter ends.
The Dow Jones industrial average, which gained more than 115 points earlier, ended up 33.47 points at 7,687.72, according to early, unofficial results. The Nasdaq index gained 1.78 to 1,438.16.

In the inflation-sensitive U.S. Treasuries market, which sold off earlier in the week, the benchmark 30-year bond was up nearly half a point, while its yield dipped to 6.75 percent from 6.78 percent Thursday.
